<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def blk(f,c):
    best=None
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==c:
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            if max(cols)<32 and (best is None or n['pixels']>best[5]):
                best=(c,min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols),n['pixels'])
    return best
def tok(f,c):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==c and n['pixels']>=4:
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rows),min(cols))
    return None

print("board_changed:",r.get('board_changed'),"done:",r.get('done'),"level_completed:",r.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
